## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the platform hosting a virtual location (Zoom, Meet, a chat service).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the kind of venue (that is [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](gmeow-virtualLocationType.md)) and avoid for the join URL ([`gmeow:accessUrl`](gmeow-accessUrl.md)).

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:virtualPlatform`](gmeow-virtualPlatform.md) as a descriptive literal alongside [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](gmeow-virtualLocationType.md) and [`gmeow:accessUrl`](gmeow-accessUrl.md).

### Examples

- ex:standup [`gmeow:virtualPlatform`](gmeow-virtualPlatform.md) "Zoom".
